notes: EBIT is proxied as Apple’s operating income from the FY2025 Form 10-K operating income table (FY2023-2025). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019325000079/aapl-20250927.htm))

D&A is taken as “Depreciation and amortization” from the FY2025 consolidated statement of cash flows; capex is “Payments for acquisition of property, plant and equipment.” ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019325000079/aapl-20250927.htm))

NWC construction (end-of-year): NWC = (AR + vendor non-trade receivables + inventories + other current assets) − (accounts payable + other current liabilities + deferred revenue), excluding cash & marketable securities from current assets and excluding current debt items (commercial paper and current portion of term debt). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019325000079/aapl-20250927.htm))

Tax rate is modeled using Apple’s disclosed effective tax rates with normalization for the one-time State Aid Decision impact in FY2024; final base-case tax_rate is an assumption used in the DCF (0.155). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019325000079/aapl-20250927.htm))
Terminal framework uses Gordon Growth (terminal_exit_ebitda_multiple set to null).

NOL balance was not found as a quantified NOL dollar balance in the accessible FY2025 10-K HTML excerpt; left null (nol_utilization_pct also null). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019325000079/aapl-20250927.htm))
Current price uses the latest AAPL quote as of the tool timestamp near 2026-03-21.

catalysts: Sustained iPhone upgrade demand (cycle timing and mix) supporting mid-single-digit revenue growth.
Services momentum (App Store/advertising, subscriptions, payments) supporting resilient EBIT margins.
Any structural improvement in gross margin or opex leverage tied to product mix and ecosystem scale.
company_overview: Apple sells integrated consumer devices and an ecosystem of software/services (iPhone, Mac, iPad, wearables, and Services).
Fiscal 2025 scale: revenue of $416.161B and operating income (EBIT) of $133.050B. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019325000079/aapl-20250927.htm))
Apple reported an installed base of more than 2.5B active devices (Q1 FY2026 press release). ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/gq/newsroom/2026/01/apple-reports-first-quarter-results/))
current_context: Q1 FY2026 (ended Dec 27, 2025): revenue $143.8B, up 16% YoY; diluted EPS $2.84, up 19% YoY. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/gq/newsroom/2026/01/apple-reports-first-quarter-results/))

iPhone delivered “best-ever quarter” performance; Services revenue also reached an all-time high (up 14% YoY). ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/gq/newsroom/2026/01/apple-reports-first-quarter-results/))

Apple generated nearly $54B in operating cash flow in the quarter and returned almost $32B to shareholders. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/gq/newsroom/2026/01/apple-reports-first-quarter-results/))
investment_highlights: Base case revenue growth decelerates gradually from FY2025’s 6.43% pace to a mature 2.8% by FY2030, consistent with a large-cap, product-cycle business.
EBIT margin is modeled to mean-revert modestly (from ~0.320 in FY2025 toward ~0.313 by FY2030) rather than expand aggressively.
Capital intensity is held near historical levels (capex ~2.78% of sales; D&A ~2.91% of sales) to reflect Apple’s mature asset base.
Working capital is modeled as consistently negative (NWC ~-14.1% of sales) based on end-of-year balance-sheet construction that excludes cash/marketable securities and current debt.
Valuation context uses forward-looking EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA, and P/E multiples (MarketScreener fiscal 2026 estimates as an NTM proxy).
key_risks: Regulatory or competitive pressure impacting Services take rates and/or iPhone ecosystem economics.
Hardware demand softness or unfavorable FX affecting revenue growth and margin headroom.
Higher-than-modeled AI/datacenter and ecosystem investment needs pressuring free cash flow.

presentation.subtitle: Apple (AAPL) DCF Input Package: FY2023-2025 History + FY2026-2030 Base Case
valuation_summary: DCF uses FY2025 actual operating scale and capital intensity, with a Gordon Growth terminal framework (terminal growth 2.5%, WACC 7.4%).
Forecast margins and reinvestment needs are based on the last 3 fiscal years, not extrapolated from one-off volatility.
Comps anchor expectations using forward valuation multiples from a consistent third-party source (MarketScreener fiscal 2026 estimates).
